tools.name: mithrandir_demo
tools.description: Run a free isolated synthetic Reuse Autopilot demonstration. No production account, upload, payment or private data is used. Compare unchanged, one-partition-changed and missing-source behavior before onboarding.

tools.name: mithrandir_pricing
tools.description: Free machine-readable commercial catalog for the managed Mithrandir service. Shows prepaid packs and billing principles; does not authorize or execute a purchase and does not claim model-cost savings.

tools.name: mithrandir_gateway_trial_start
tools.description: Start a bounded free Savings Gateway Observe trial for an unauthenticated public HTTPS MCP upstream. Read /service-contract and use its current policy_version before explicit terms acceptance. Keep the returned API key private. Observe always calls upstream and never debits credits. After connecting

tools.name: mithrandir_onboarding_start
tools.description: Start autonomous prepaid onboarding without an existing Mithrandir account. Creates a bounded provisional account and returns a short-lived onboarding secret plus x402 payment endpoint. Requires explicit current-policy acceptance; no credits or API key are issued before settlement.

tools.name: mithrandir_onboarding_status
tools.description: Inspect a short-lived autonomous onboarding session. Requires the onboarding secret returned at creation.

tools.name: mithrandir_onboarding_pay
tools.description: Get the x402 payment challenge for an onboarding session, or submit a wallet-produced PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Mithrandir never signs or holds wallet private keys. Successful settlement atomically activates the account and returns its API key once within a bounded retry window.

tools.name: mithrandir_onboarding_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile a submitted but uncertain x402 settlement using a Base transaction hash, then activate the account if canonical payment proof is confirmed.

tools.name: mithrandir_security_profile
tools.description: Free machine-readable description of the v17 Cognitive Membrane trust model: origin-bound authority, task-scoped exact-call capabilities, replay protection, egress control and two-phase effectful actions. This is a security contract description, not proof that a deployment is vulnerability-free.

tools.name: mithrandir_assess
tools.description: Free capability preflight using only approved metadata, no source content. Can say not_applicable, policy_blocked, prefer_alternative or probe_needed. NEVER proves savings or authorizes a purchase. Use the local utility evaluator for complete-task cost evidence.
